description:
Get a specific booking by ID from Holded CRM.

Args:
  - booking_id (string): The booking ID to retrieve (required)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Booking details including startTime, endTime, duration, status, service, space, outcome, and customFieldsValues.

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data or 'markdown' for human-readable

name: holded_crm_get_booking
title: Get Holded Booking
